field_text_formatted.value: On the frontend, Druxt's <DruxtView> component renders that exact route as Vue components, filters, sorting and pagination included, no custom resource on either side. It's the frontend half of the same pipeline. DruxtViews targets Nuxt 2 today; a Nuxt 3/4-compatible Druxt is actively in progress, more on that soon.
